correctness.rationale: For Q4 the graph condition is exactly selected vertices have at least two selected neighbors, and unselected vertices at least one. All 2^16 masks were examined by source and by separate independently implemented C++ enumeration. For Q5, write D=A∪B' by Q4 layers; any D satisfies the 2-limited constraint iff P(A)∧P(B)∧R(A)⊆B∧R(B)⊆A, where P requires ≥2 within-layer selected neighbors at each selected vertex and R selects the deficits (selected with exactly two, or unselected with none). This is an exact decomposition of every 32-bit set. Both programs enumerated all 8122 possible layers and all 8122²=65,966,884 ordered pairs without early pruning; independent output exactly 16 and 1830, while Q4 gives 8 and 428. The coordinate flip/adjacent-coordinate-swap generators span the entire cube automorphism group and independent BFS agrees with all six orbit sizes and canonical reps. This is exhaustive finite proof for Q4,Q5, not an inference to larger cubes.
